title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Moment Of Jest〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great job, everyone♪
I think we really outdid ourselves this time too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, Kanade, for uploading the song this morning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, Kanade, you're staring a hole into that menu there. Did you skip meals again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I haven't eaten anything since yesterday, because I wanted to upload the song as soon as I could.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then we should order quickly so that Kanade can get some food into her system soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ah, I'll get some fries then.
It shouldn't take long for them to be served♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What would you like, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Again? If anything's fine then just pick something.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case... I'll get some fries too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, let's get a large serving and eat together!
Excuse me, waiter! We'd like to order!

rows.Speaker: Diner Staff
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting. Here's your extra large fries.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Food's here! Oh, but the fries are still piping hot.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Life's tough when you have a sensitive tongue...
Oh, Kanade and Ena, feel free to help yourself♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sure. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't mind if I do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's wrong, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I taste nothing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh... I know!
Why don't we drizzle some soy sauce on them?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
If you do that, only Mafuyu will be able to eat the fries.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, the fries are already salted, so why are you trying to make them even saltier?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There are so many better seasonings we could eat the fries with, like avocado dips and cheese dips, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unfortunately, they don't provide that here. For condiments, there are only soy sauce and ketchup. Hey, how about we put even more salt on the fries, then?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm fine with anything.
It'll just taste the same to me, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You may be fine, but I'm not!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I saw a few dipping sauces on the menu just now. Should we order some?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So they do have dipping sauces here!
Why were you trying to put us through that risky taste experiment, then?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not at all! We should absolutely try figuring something out with just the condiments available on the table!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's the point?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Well, I guess the mood's definitely better than before.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We've all got stuff going on in our lives, so it's not like we can be normal friends, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Getting to know Mafuyu better through the doll exhibition was a major milestone.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got everyone to go, even if I had to be a little forceful about it. We're not so awkward around each other anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm such a thoughtful and considerate person!
Whoa, hang on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey! Why're the fries already almost gone?
I was just waiting for them to cool down a little!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You told us to help ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes, but you'd usually hold back a little, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's hard to stop once you start, especially for fries.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I find it intriguing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Not you too, Kanade... Wait!
Of course. Kanade's stomach was completely empty just now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. But I'm full now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ah... There goes most of my fries...
Mafuyu, you should really stop eating with such a businesslike face.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you want this instead?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Ena, you're so nice! But that's lasagna, right? You know I can't eat food that's too hot!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hot food tears the skin in my mouth to shreds!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't make it sound so gross.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, your order is here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The plate of fries is kind of blocking the table. Let's get the waiter to clear it for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Ah! My fries! They're all gone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Waiter! Another large portion of fries please!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, and when it's ready, could you please let it cool down a little before bringing it out? Thanks...
